title: ego: workspace trust persists per root across seats
content: Story 193-a726, ADR docs/decisions/2026-09-28-one-workspace-trust-answer-across-seats.md: one explicit trust/refusal answer per canonical workspace root is shared by ACP hosts and terminal via $EGO_HOME/trust.json. Re-ask only on executable changes in parsed project MCP/hook declarations or referenced in-workspace programs; instruction and skill changes do not invalidate. Ledger v2 stores redacted declaration/program snapshots for a before/after re-ask, env keys but no values. ACP cancel, no choice, or transport failure never writes. Existing digest-only grants are honored and migrated. Old ACP session-only trust decision superseded.

title: ego: Step 14 enforces permissions, sandbox, and the auto judge
content: Step 14 is a real end-to-end safety path, not an availability placeholder. Canonical allow and deny rules, the mode floor and ceiling, and workspace boundary classify exact PreparedCall operations before an unforgeable Permit reaches GuardedEffects. Exec preserves one exact SpawnSpec through policy and execution. Landlock and Seatbelt backends advertise only behaviorally measured capabilities and fail closed when the requested confinement or offline posture is unavailable; the null backend grants no confinement. Auto mode runs one separately resolved tool-less judge attempt through the shared BudgetGate, records GenerationRole::Judge and bounded durable reasoning, and maps malformed, failed, oversized, or uncertain output to escalation without retry or execution. Exact Luna closure evidence: 1503 workspace tests passed across 80 suites, clippy with warnings denied, formatting, and diff checks. Sources: story 032-0f75, ARCHITECTURE.md sections 3.4 and 8, CLI.md section 3.1, and the accepted confinement and judge ADRs.

title: ego: skills are progressively disclosed source-bound capabilities
content: epsilon-go loads strict SKILL.md files from system, user, and trusted project roots. Model-visible metadata is bounded and announced like MCP; bodies and rooted resources load only after one typed user or model invocation. Current Agent Skills and Claude frontmatter is implemented or refused by field name, permissions never widen, shell injection is refused, and rendered content plus digest is durable.
